name: qwerty-soft-signal
description: Qwerty Soft — Signal: a fast, accessible WordPress block theme by Qwerty Soft.
author: Qwerty Soft (https://qwerty-soft.com/)
//: The theme itself has no build step — what is in the repository is what ships. Node is only used for the quality gates below.

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:wp
scripts.test: npm run audit:contrast && npm run lint:blocks && npm run lint:php && npm run test:unit
scripts.i18n: npm run make:pot && npm run make:mo
scripts.release: npm run test && npm run build:zip
